resources.string: QuickControl helps you access essential phone controls without physical buttons.\n\nA small handle on the left edge of your screen gives you instant access to volume, flashlight, screen lock, and more — from any app.
QuickControl needs permission to appear over other apps so the Edge Panel can be accessed from anywhere.
To lock your screen without the power button, QuickControl needs Device Administrator permission. This only enables the lock screen feature.
To open the Android Power Menu (for restart/shutdown), QuickControl needs Accessibility Service permission. This is only used to trigger the system power dialog.
Enable Device Admin in app settings to use Lock Screen
Enable Accessibility Service in app settings to use Power Menu
Flashlight is not available on this device
Shows when QuickControl edge panel is active
Swipe from the left edge to access controls
Automatically start QuickControl when your phone boots up

To keep QuickControl available at all times, you may need to disable battery optimization for this app.

On OPPO/ColorOS devices:
1. Go to Settings → Battery
2. Find QuickControl
3. Allow background activity
4. Disable battery optimization

This prevents the system from stopping QuickControl in the background.
QuickControl v1.0\nA simple utility to replace physical button controls.
QuickControl uses this service only to open the Android Power Menu when you press the Power Menu button in the edge panel. No other accessibility features are used.
QuickControl uses Device Administrator permission only to lock the screen when you press the Lock Screen button.
